s.g: (fantasy, roleplaying games, video games, countable) A gemstone with magical properties.
A woolly material obtained from the dried leaves of an Asian species of mugwort, such as Artemisia argyi, as used in moxibustion.
Any other substance used in moxibustion.
(folk medicine) The burning of moxa against the skin to treat pain or illness.
A member of an indigenous people of Bolivia.
